curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42022-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds the hot rod; book 2, 42022-1-2.pdf, is the alternate roadster)

functions.does: The knob on the upright post behind the cab steers the front wheels: a bevel gear at its foot turns a long shaft forward along the chassis, whose knob gears turn a short arm that pushes the steering link across to both front wheels.
functions.source: book: steps 1-20 (step 20's red frame shows the knob turning and the front wheels steering)

functions.does: Rolling the car turns the V6 engine: one rear wheel's axle drives, through bevel gears and a shaft forward to an 8-tooth gear pair, the crankshaft, and the six pistons go up and down in their cylinders.
functions.source: book: rear axle steps 1-9, engine steps 25-33; function page 80
functions.note: the pistons slide straight up and down in fixed cylinders; only one rear wheel is geared to the engine, the other rolls on its own axle

functions.does: The other rear wheel and the two front wheels roll freely.
The black gear knob on the cab's side opens the body: turning it swings the blue side panels open and folds the black seat-back frame forward, through two long links; turned back, it closes them.
functions.source: book: step 52 (the red frame: 1 open, 2 closed, with the turning arrow on the knob); function page 80 (the inset)
